marketing_description: The Trex® T-Rail Kit (part 543302126) features a 6‑ft T‑Top composite rail in white, paired with square composite balusters in the same color. Designed for horizontal installation, the kit includes pre‑drilled holes for easy assembly and is part of the Trex Select® Classic Collection. It offers low maintenance, weather resistance, durability, and eco‑friendly, cost‑effective performance while remaining compatible with Trex decking.
